policy.isbn: primary_isbn ∉ isbn[]: add primary_isbn to isbn[] when Open Library titles it as this book AND (the wiki lists it OR it is the same OL work as a row ISBN); reset primary_isbn to a row ISBN when the evidence assigns it to another book; flag anything else. Operator-approved additions (listed in the builder, each in the row's wiki infobox and on no other row) are appended in the same write. The only removal: an operator-approved collision removal (listed in the builder) drops an ISBN two rows share from the row it does not belong to, only while the owner row still holds it, never the row's primary_isbn, and never when Open Library titles it as this row's book. An operator-approved invalid-ISBN removal (listed in the builder) drops a value that fails the ISBN-13 check digit; when it was primary_isbn, primary_isbn moves to the named valid ISBN, which must be on the row. An operator-approved misfiled-ISBN removal (listed in the builder) drops a valid ISBN that is a different book, never when Open Library files it under the same work as an ISBN the row keeps; when it was primary_isbn, primary_isbn resets to the named or wiki-infobox row ISBN, which must be valid and on the row.
policy.covers: null/blank cover_image only: Open Library (every row ISBN), then Google Books (every row ISBN), then a Google Books title search accepted only when the hit lists a row ISBN; HEAD-checked against MIN_COVER_BYTES, never a cover another row uses, never a Wookieepedia image. Only when all of those find nothing for a released book: the cover of the Open Library work a row ISBN belongs to (openlibrary-work), else — only when no row ISBN is on Open Library — the single work an OL title + author search returns (openlibrary-search, "different edition: title+author match"; first published no later than the row, in English, Canon works 2014+). Both need the full normalized title + author-set match, the same HEAD/shared/wiki guards, and an operator visual review of that exact image; they may show a different printing. Unreleased books without one are listed, not forced. An operator-approved cover (listed in the builder: an image for a row ISBN from a source no automated pass reads, e.g. the publisher, downloaded and visually reviewed) wins over all of the above, under the same blank-row, HEAD, shared and wiki guards, and only for an ISBN on the row.
policy.synopsis: null/blank synopsis only: original one-line drafts (never wiki CC BY-SA prose or publisher blurbs), each marked drafted for review; rows without a confident draft are skipped and listed.
